feeds.title: Saving Country Music
feeds.description: Saving Country Music's purpose is spelled out in its name. It offers news, opinion, reviews, artist profiles, music history, and the always-popular off-color pop country bashing. Saving Country Music primarily focuses on country, but also covers roots, rockabilly, bluegrass, blues, and folk music.

feeds.title: Ear To The Ground Music
feeds.description: EarToTheGround Music features emerging artists primarily in folk, indie rock, and roots music scenes. The site has album reviews, artist interviews, and artist spotlights featuring a number of lesser-known musicians. It is the purpose of the site to curate the digital music world, helping artists find an audience and music fans find exceptional, high-quality music

feeds.title: Sing Out!
feeds.description: Founded in 1950, the mission of Sing Out! is to preserve and support the cultural diversity and heritage of all traditional and contemporary folk music. They also want to encourage individuals to make folk music a part of their daily lives. Check out the latest posts for news and reviews of folk music.

feeds.title: Twangville
feeds.description: Twangville is a Music Review blog featuring Alt-Country, Americana, Indie, Rock, Folk & Blues. Emphasizing the Alt side of Alt-country, we cover releases, reviews, downloads, links, and more. Explore Reader's Picks, Artist interviews, and more in our latest posts.

feeds.title: For The Love Of Bands » Folk
feeds.description: Discover new and upcoming folk music albums and artists. For The Love Of Bands is an online magazine and indie music blog launched in 2016. The blog's main focus is on independent music but also covers a variety of indie, upcoming and emerging bands and artists.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound » Folk
feeds.description: Indie music blog featuring quality, emerging artists through streaming audio and in-depth reviews. Obscure Sound covers emerging independent artists, featuring audio streams and detailed write-ups.

feeds.title: Folk Alley
feeds.description: Folk Alley is a public service, produced by the FreshGrass Foundation, that strives to bring folk, roots, and Americana music to the world via the Internet, reaching across the miles and the generations to provide global exposure for an art form with long-standing tradition and a loyal fan community.

feeds.title: Edmonton Folk Music Festival
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates about the Edmonton FOlk Music Festival. Held every year in August in Edmonton, the EFMF is one of the leading folk festivals in the world.

feeds.title: A&R Factory » Folk
feeds.description: View our Folk music blog and promotion page to browse and find different music submitted by various artists. Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. Find out more here! We help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world.

feeds.title: For The Rabbits
feeds.description: For The Rabbits is an independent music site for new and old music.

feeds.title: Metal Music Blog » Folk Metal
feeds.description: Collection of Top and latest Folk Metal genre albums and releases, which are free to download for review in rar and mp3 format. Metal music blog has a widespread hitrate from all the continents and countries in the world. Very few albums arrive to many of these countries. We also make the music spread.

feeds.title: ArtistRack » Folk
feeds.description: ArtistRack shares the best folk melodies, artists, compositions, and more with folk lovers in this segment. ArtistRack is one of the world's leading music promotion platforms. Loud, proud, and trusted for its hot insights, the platform launched in 2012 and helps artists to connect with new fans around the world.

feeds.title: Beautiful Song Of The Week » Folk
feeds.description: Beautiful Song Of The Week is a blog about uncovering the world's loveliest music. Every week I will add a new beautiful song, accompanied by a brief explanation of why I've included it. Explore my list of folk music to uncover forgotten musics.

feeds.title: Fierce 'n' Furious Folk Music
feeds.description: Webzine with tons of reviews (albums and concerts), interviews, news on Folk-metal, Celtic/Folk Punk and Medieval Rock. You will find all you want to know about fierce and furious folk-related music here.

feeds.title: Ear To The Ground Music » Folk
feeds.description: Browse through our articles featuring new and upcoming folk artists and albums in this section. EarToTheGround is a music website featuring emerging musicians covering a variety of musical styles, with a focus on folk and Indie Rock.

feeds.title: Darren's music Blog » Folk Music
feeds.description: Read news, reviews, interviews, and more about folk music only on Darren's music blog. Welcome to my music blog. I have fairly varied tastes in music: folk, rock, glam, heavy metal, and more. My blog pretty much explains my journey of musical discovery over the years and the eclectic range of reviews.

feeds.title: Rock The Pigeon » Folk
feeds.description: Explore our articles covering the Folk music industry, artists' news and more! Rock The Pigeon started as an anonymously written music blog. We cover all types of music, art, culture, and stories from all around the world.

feeds.title: Cheers to the Vikings » Indie Folk
feeds.description: Cheers to the Vikings sharing their love of Indie Folk in this segment of the blog. Cheers To The Vikings is a platform that launched in 2016 as a SoundCloud account, We are dedicated to discovering and featuring exceptional artists. This is the music that moves us. We think it will move you too.

feeds.title: Folking.com
feeds.description: UK folk + Americana music website folking.com with album reviews features festivals gig listings interviews and music related videos. The site was established in 1999 and has become one of the UK's much-loved online folk music resources.

feeds.title: Music Mecca » Folk
feeds.description: Check out news and interviews on the folk music industry, songwriters, singers and more! Nashville-centric music blog showcasing non-mainstream artists via interviews, premieres, features, playlist curations, & more.

feeds.title: Faeton Music Blog » folk
feeds.description: Open new names and discover the folk music, listen to the most interesting and always fresh stuff with us! This is Faeton Music Blog and Daily Track by Faeton Music. Faeton Music Blog / Daily Track website is running by the music lover, for music lovers. The main reason why I've made and regularly updating this website - is to open for people new and interesting music.

feeds.title: Acoustic Music Scene
feeds.description: Get the latest News & Commentary for the Folk, Roots & Singer-Songwriter Communities. Showcasing advance notice and coverage of awards and contests, conferences of note, and music festivals, AcousticMusicScene.com is designed to promote quality acoustic music by providing you with useful news and insightful commentary.

feeds.title: Whalebone Blog
feeds.description: Whalebone Eclectic Instrumental Acoustic Folk Music woven with strands of Rock Blog.

feeds.title: Unicorn Magazine
feeds.description: Unicorn Magazine is a FREE quarterly 32 to 48 page A5 publication for Folk Music, Song and Dance enthusiasts in the area of Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire and the nearer parts of the surrounding counties. The magazine contains regular items, such as our comprehensive Club Diary, the invaluable Morris Diary, and vital details about music and song sessions.

feeds.title: Melody Blog
feeds.description: Melody's Traditional Music provides interesting and educational articles, helping you to connect with the composers and arrangers whose music we represent.

feeds.title: Record Crates United » Folk
feeds.description: Follow and read articles on astonishing Folk records, singers, labels, and more in this segment of Record Crates United. Since 2012, Keith Hadad's Record Crates United has been a home for wayward music. Artists and sounds from the past and present that may have or at least deserve to have a cult following will have their time here.

feeds.title: Kinn Folk Music
feeds.description: Stay up to date on shows and events along with the life happenings of KInnFolk. Josh and Julie Kinn weave bouzouki, bodhran, and smooth vocal harmonies in their Celtic folk music from the heart of the Blue Ridge Mountains. Since forming Kinnfolk in late 2018, the pair have played at festivals and listening rooms throughout Virginia and beyond.

feeds.title: My Soundposter Blog » Indie Folk
feeds.description: Explore our Indie Folk section for the latest news and updates from the industry, new music, albums and more! This blog started as a side project of the New York-based Soundposter Inc. We strive to support independent artists to be heard and seen. But also to collect and preserve the context of music.

feeds.title: Spiral Earth
feeds.description: Spiral Earth features the best in folk and roots music, plus World, Blues, and Acoustic. Covering festivals in the UK and Europe. Spiral Earth is the most significant online news channel and website for the UK Folk, Roots, and alternative music scene, offering a unique combination of up-to-the-minute news, reviews, and commentary to its readership.

feeds.title: The Blue Moment » Folk music
feeds.description: Read posts about Folk music written by Richard Williams in the following section of the blog. Hi! I'm Richard Williams. Since the late 1960s, I've written about music. A list of the people I've most enjoyed interviewing during that time would include Marvin Gaye, Laura Nyro, Booker T. Jones, Miles Davis, and more. The Blue Moment is about music by me.

feeds.description: Right Chord Music champions incredible unsigned music, we are a top 50 ranked UK music blog. Our Lost On Radio Podcast has found listeners in 150 countries. Right Chord Music (RCM) champion incredible undiscovered & under-appreciated music from around the world.

feeds.title: Jamie O'Reilly Blog
feeds.description: The Jamie O'Reilly blog is a personal, event-rich space where the Chicago-based folk singer shares updates on her music projects, Roots Salon gatherings, concert E‑newsletters, song stories, community initiatives like the Legacy and Voices of Old Chicago projects, and reflections on life, health, and art.

feeds.title: Music You Need To Hear Folk
feeds.description: The folk section on Music You Need to Hear (Beijing‑based music discovery blog) features curated posts on niche folk subgenres—like apocalyptic, Baltic, and neofolk.

feeds.title: Roots Music Canada
feeds.description: Your home on the web for all things Canadian folk, roots, blues, and world music and related genres.

feeds.title: Pasadena Folk Music Society
feeds.description: Presenting the best in folk music from around the country and around the world...since 1983.

feeds.title: Openhouse Folk Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the Openhouse Folk music blog, featuring insights, stories, and updates from the world of folk music. Explore the latest in folk.

feeds.title: mySoundposter » Folk
feeds.description: mySoundposter's Folk archive is a heartfelt window into the modern folk revival — stories, songs, and soul woven together in singer-songwriter simplicity.

feeds.title: Jon Wilks Blog
feeds.description: Explore Jon Wilks' blog: writing on English folk songs, traditions, touring

feeds.title: Charlie Mosbrook Blog
feeds.description: A heartfelt blog where folk singer-songwriter Charlie Mosbrook shares stories, reflections, and new music rooted in the tradition of acoustic folk.

feeds.title: The Guardian Folk Music
feeds.description: Latest news, sport, business, comment, analysis and reviews of folk music from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.description: An Online Music Magazine via London, Bristol and London covering Acoustic/Folk, Electronic, Hip-Hop, Indie, Jazz, Reggae, RnB, Soul and World music vibes.

feeds.title: Celtic Folk Punk And More
feeds.description: Celtic punk, Celtic rock and folk punk videos, album reviews, free downloads, etc. from the whole world.

feeds.title: Music Enthusiast » Folk-rock
feeds.description: Browse through my Folk-Rock section for all the interesting tidbits about the genre, artists and more! This blog is here to chat about music, rock and roll, blues, jazz, pop, r&b, and soul. Part of my 'mission' with this site is to keep older music alive, to let it not be forgotten.

feeds.title: Post To Wire » Folk
feeds.description: Post To Wire is your source to unearth and listen to Folk music, albums, singles, artists, and more. Post To Wire is a blog dedicated to the different strands of Americana music. We publish reviews, interviews, news, and multimedia content from alt-country, folk, blues, and rock 'n' roll artists from Australia, New Zealand, and around the world.

feeds.title: Everything Sundry Folk Music
feeds.description: Kathy shares her love for folk music on her blog Everything Sundry. Hello, it's me: Kathy Sands-Boehmer. I am a content developer for a major textbook publisher by day. I am also the booking manager for the me&thee coffeehouse in Marblehead, MA. A great deal of my life revolves around music-getting to know new artists and reacquainting myself with more well-established ones.

feeds.title: New Folk Initiative Blog
feeds.description: Read commentary on music, theater, and films from John Platt, founder of the New Folk Initiative. The New Folk Initiative is an inclusive resource for the propagation and promotion of folk music in its multi-faceted forms. Our site contains playlists for the Sunday Supper; selected sessions from the WFUV archives; previews for On Your Radar; a curated concert calendar, and more.

feeds.title: Folkmama's Blog
feeds.description: The Folkmama Blog showcases top folk artists brought to the Harrisburg/York/Lancaster, Pennsylvania area by the Susquehanna Folk Music Society, either as part of its regular season programming or as part of the Susquehanna Folk Festival presented by the society each July. Folkmama was created by Jess Hayden, SFMS Executive Director and Festival Director. Blog posts are written by Jess Hayden, Peter Winter, and others.

feeds.title: FolkWorks Blog
feeds.description: FolkWorks is the source for folk/roots/traditional music, dance, and related folk arts - vibrant, and often overlooked by the popular media. We feature articles and columns, interviews and CD reviews contributed by folks in the community.

feeds.title: Inside the Folkosphere
feeds.description: Folk music blog. News from the folk music world plus occasional updates and musings on what's happening 'backstage' at FolkCast - the UK's premier folk music Podcast with thousands of listeners all over the world.

feeds.title: Australian Folk Music and Australian Folk Singers and Musicians
feeds.description: Focusing on Australian folk music, Australian bush ballads and/or Australian folk musicians.

feeds.title: Al's Folk Music Blog
feeds.description: Santa Fe folk singer Al Acuff shares his thoughts on subjects ranging from acoustic guitar amplification to songwriting and performing. Topics of interest to folksingers, singer/songwriters and those who love folk music and country blues guitar.

feeds.title: Folk Music with Steve and Kristi
feeds.description: Americana duo on guitar, bass and harmony and lead vocals featuring mostly original songs.

feeds.title: Natalie Gelman Blog
feeds.description: Singer/Songwriter Natalie writes blogs about life on the road, handmade things, gardening, working out, thoughts on life, and experiences she's had. Basically whatever she wants to share that day! Read it all here in her online journal.

feeds.title: Common Folk Music
feeds.description: A blog about music, not just folk music, but all music ranging from indie to alt-country to bluegrass, because music is for the 'Common Folk'. We strive to provide fair and balanced reviews and artist features opening the door and making the way smoother for independent musicians, as well as, changing America's musical preference one person at a time.

feeds.title: For Folk's Sake
feeds.description: For Folk's Sake is a UK-based website run by a team of music enthusiasts from around the country. We write about folk, country and roots music- and anything else that we happen to like.

feeds.title: KLOF Magazine
feeds.description: The UK's leading online Folk Music Magazine covers independent Non-mainstream music including Folk, Acoustic, Americana, Experimental, and Alternative music. Founded in 2004 by Alex Gallacher, KLOF Mag is an eclectic music and culture zine featuring recommendations and reviews, interviews & guest features, and more. Their writers include journalists, former writers for the music press, and those who share their passion for the music they love.

feeds.title: WPR » Folk
feeds.description: Wisconsin Public Radio features in-depth news and discussions on folk and classical music & artists. Wisconsin Public Radio is a civic and cultural resource that exists to enlighten and enrich the quality of life for its listeners.

feeds.title: Various Small Flames
feeds.description: At Various Small Flames, we believe that music and writing have the power to connect people and help them better understand themselves and each other. We are dedicated to sharing music from independent artists, especially home recordings and DIY labels, that we feel do this particularly well.

feeds.title: Cover Lay Down | Folk covers, familiar songs.
feeds.description: Bonus tracks, found coverage, and previews. Because in the folk tradition, music belongs to the community. Cover Lay Down posts new coverfolk features twice weekly, explicitly for the purpose of introducing you to new and previously-unappreciated musicians, that you might follow the threads to those artists' original works.

feeds.title: The Reviews Are In » Folk
feeds.description: Explore News, reviews, updates, quizzes, contests, and more awesome stuff from the world of folk music. The Reviews Are In is primarily a two-person operation with Joshua Murray acting as Lead Editor and Primary Writer, and Trish Cassling acting as Lead Photographer and Writer.

feeds.title: Folk Alliance International
feeds.description: Folk Alliance International (FAI) was founded in 1989 to connect folk music leaders aiming to sustain the community and genre, providing all the latest news from the industry. The leading international voice for folk music, FAI is an arts nonprofit and NEA designated National Arts Service Organization based in Kansas City, Missouri, USA. FAI is also a member of the Alliance of Performing Arts Conferences (APAC) and the Performing Arts Alliance (PAA).

feeds.title: ChillFiltr » Music
feeds.description: We share and write about awesome indie music. Always ready to listen to something. ChillFiltr was built for one simple reason: to bring a spotlight to independent artists from around the world. With our Spotify playlists, ChillFiltr Radio, and daily coverage of our favorite releases we strive to bring the best new art to a worldwide audience-by leveraging best-in-class technology to create a seamless and immersive web experience.

feeds.title: Folk Music Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Folk Music Ontario is the largest folk and roots music organization in Canada and serves its members as a recognized arts service organization. FMO is the organization for people who make and support folk and roots music in Ontario and hosts Canada's largest annual folk music conference.

feeds.title: Independent Music Reviews » Indie Folk
feeds.description: Your resource for Inspired Independent folk artists and inspiring albums. An indie music blog that contains album reviews, music news, new releases, just released singles and videos. We attempt to review most of the albums on the site, and are always looking for your feedback on the albums we review.

feeds.title: Nexus Music Blog » Folk
feeds.description: Here at Nexus, we keep you up to date with a selection of the best up and coming Folk music. Nexus Music Blog was started from humble beginnings in 2017 with the aim of highlighting artists that were both ignored by bigger platforms yet unique enough to deserve the credit and coverage that they were seeking. We started as a one-person team throughout 2017 and swiftly grew heading into 2018. We now have a team of five and we cover a broad range of topics which include reviews, interviews, live events, premieres, playlists and much more.

feeds.title: Folk, Bluegrass & Traditional Music
feeds.description: Articles, photos and videos about folk, bluegrass and traditional music, from the old-timey styles to the contemporary.
